slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

volunteer first

the next time someone asks for a volunteer, raise your hand before you have time to think. you'll rarely regret saying yes, but you remember every time you stayed small.

learning names

learn the name of one person you see every week, the barista, the guard, a neighbour, and use it. remembering names makes every room feel a little more like yours.

standing calls

take every important call standing up and walking around. your voice drops, you breathe slower, and the other person hears someone who is sure of what they're saying.

five minute deep dives

pick one topic you know nothing about and give it 5 minutes a day: an art movement, a scientist, an ancient city. curiosity makes you interesting, and interesting people are calm around anyone.

slides.texte_overlay:
complaint fasting

go 7 days without complaining out loud about anything at all, not even the weather. you'll notice how often you hand your power to things you can't even change.
